# T-1: Relocate cleanup writes

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Route finalize-cleanup-time flow state, metrics, notes, issue-log, runtime-derived, and plugin artifact writes away from the target worktree after the read-only boundary.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Cleanup-time writes after target resolution use main repo or durable cleanup locations.
- The target worktree remains unchanged by cleanup-created flow.json metrics or plugin artifact writes before removal.
- Final flow state, step status, issue-log audit, report data, plugin hook result, pointer update, and active-flow clear remain observable.
- Post-command dispatcher/agent runtimeLog metadata and metrics do not mutate final flow.json after the cleanup commit.

## Implementation Notes
Reuse FinalizeCleanupPathResolver and existing FlowManager/FlowStore routing. Keep source code generic and avoid references to Issue #396 in src/.

## Test Strategy
Spec-local tests should simulate cleanup-time metrics/plugin writes and post-command dispatcher/agent metadata, then assert target worktree flow.json does not change and main flow.json is not dirtied after the final commit.
